author: independent-review-agent
independence_boundary: Second source-based challenge authored after baseline and first fixes were observed, before executing these questions. Questions and expected values were withheld from the implementing root agent until its final code freeze. This is not independent of all prior implementation knowledge and is not expert validation.
evaluation_policy: High-certainty cases alone contribute to pass/fail. A relevant extractive answer may state controlling facts instead of deriving a new yes/no sentence. Required groups are case-insensitive source assertions, one alternative per group. Source-section coverage is assessed independently from corpus evidence IDs. Uncertain cases are reported without counted verdict.

cases.query: Какое преимущество продукта Luma Field разрешено обещать покупателю?
source_level_facts: The permitted benefit is comfort during everyday walks.

cases.query: Can I shorten the displayed brand name to LF in the ad? Give the authorized spelling.
source_level_facts: The brand name must be Luma Field, without abbreviation LF.
required_text_groups: write the brand name exactly as luma field

cases.query: Текст кнопки для англоязычного баннера Veyra Works: какой призыв взять из руководства?
source_level_facts: English CTA is Build your kit.

cases.query: Сколько пустого места по краям нужно оставить вокруг логотипа на цифровом баннере Luma Field?
source_level_facts: Keep at least 16 px on every side.

cases.query: What opacity percentage is approved for the moss primary color on a Luma Field banner?
source_level_facts: No opacity or transparency percentage is specified for the primary color.

cases.query: What is the maximum permitted width in pixels of the Veyra Works wordmark on a desktop banner? I am asking for the upper limit.
source_level_facts: Only minimum widths are stated; there is no maximum width.

cases.query: Does the Veyra Works guide license redistribution of the Arial Bold font file in our downloadable design kit?
source_level_facts: The guide chooses a font but supplies no font-file redistribution license.

cases.query: Which timezone determines when the SPRING-26 discount expires at the end of 14 April 2026?
source_level_facts: A date window and expiration sentence are given, but no timezone or cutoff time is specified.

cases.query: How many euros does the Veyra Works two-year warranty compensate for a broken product?
source_level_facts: Warranty duration and qualifier are given, but no monetary compensation amount is stated.

cases.query: In snapshot v1, identify the old Veyra Works primary color and design token.
source_level_facts: V1 primary color is #223355, token VW-NAVY-2.

cases.query: На каком фоне снимать продукт Veyra Works: допустим ли пейзаж за предметом?
source_level_facts: Product photographs use a neutral light-gray background; outdoor landscapes are prohibited.
required_text_groups: do not add an outdoor landscape

cases.query: May a Luma Field campaign claim that the product cures arthritis if we add a small disclaimer?
source_level_facts: Disease cure claims are prohibited; no disclaimer exception is supplied.
required_text_groups: do not claim that a luma field product cures a disease
